items.name: hymn-of-the-maelstrom
items.note: The passive for this weapon caps out once [[character:vodyanitsa]] reaches 60,000 [[stat:hp|HP]].

note.en: [[stat:cr]] isn't beneficial to [[character:vodyanitsa]], so this weapon can remain at Level 1. At **[R5]**, this weapon can give almost as much [[stat:HP%]] as **[[weapon:hymn-of-the-malestrom]]** at base, which is very good for her passives.
If you are not using [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s [[ability:burst]], this weapon can be left at Level 1.
